messages.author: 695eaec5c92d8703
messages.subject: Rsubread::featureCounts(junccounts=TRUE,...) emits no file
parts:
I find that using RSubread with junccounts=TRUE will report the total number of junction in its report to stdout, but does produce any text file listing the junctions.

I looked in the working directory and in the directory containing the .bam files being scanned, and it appears in neither.

Any suggestions?

Thanks,

Malcolm

messages.author: bce99ba71cd48eea
messages.subject: Re: Rsubread::featureCounts(junccounts=TRUE,...) emits no file
parts:
Hi Malcolm,

Please save the result of the R function into a variable; otherwise the return values will be directly written to STDOUT by R.

For example,

> x <- featureCounts('my-junction-mapping.BAM', annot.inbuilt="hg19",  isPairedEnd=T, juncCounts = T)

> x$counts_junction[1:10,]

Cheers,
Yang
